title: thyrsacanthus secundus
intro: Thyrsacanthus secundus, commonly known as the "Yellow Trumpet" or "Yellow Trumpet Flower," is a flowering plant species native to Mexico. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which may help alleviate congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of Thyrsacanthus secundus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits, including antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
